grades.quote: Local interrupt enable bits, which are high valid. These local interrupt enable bits correspond to the 13 interrupt sources recorded in the IS field in CSR.ESTAT. Each bit controls one interrupt source.
grades.reason: Describes ECFG.LIE as per-source local interrupt enable bits that map to the interrupt sources recorded in ESTAT.IS, which is a key part of how ECFG and ESTAT gate interrupts. It does not mention CRMD.IE or the full combined delivery condition.
Table of contents only. It lists register section titles and gives no information about how the registers control interrupt delivery.

grades.quote: 1 indicates that the external interrupt uses the message interrupt mode, otherwise it is the level interrupt line mode
grades.reason: The CPUCFG word 0x1 MSG_INT bit says whether external interrupts use message mode or level interrupt line mode. This is limited background on line-based interrupts. It says nothing about CRMD.IE, ECFG or ESTAT.
Covers TLBRPRMD saving and restoring mode bits around a TLB refill exception. It does not explain how CRMD.IE, ECFG and ESTAT gate line-based interrupt delivery.
